summary: Permit a narrow compile-time-constant executeJavaScript path only after reparsing/analyzing the source as JavaScript AST.

target.notes: Preserve Electron WebContents/Chromium renderer semantics through the ElectronCompat host boundary; do not replace navigation, rendering, printing, or DevTools with ordinary .NET calls.

semantics.precondition: source is compile-time constant and frontend reparses/validates it; generic dynamic strings use existing electron.webcontents.executejavascript unsupported rule

tests.name: constant reparse
tests.expected_behavior: eligible only if compiler reparses script into AST and preserves renderer realm; never text-rewritten into C#

tests.name: dynamic excluded
tests.expected_behavior: falls to existing unsupported dynamic-code rule
